content.short: Tokenized Real Estate RWAs on the blockchain.
content.description:
Whimsy is a fractionalized real estate investment platform that sources, manages, leases and maintains long & short term rental properties. All properties listed with Whimsy are fully compliant in the United States using the SEC REG A exemption. All buying and selling is submitted, reviewed, approved and reported by our FINRA broker-dealer partners.

Whimsy will provide solutions through the use of blockchain-based technology, that emphasis in long & short term rental markets. Our goal is to provide a simple to use application that revolutionizes the real estate industry by empowering communities to buy back their neighborhoods.
